en.askTitle: Change the boxes to your own move and get the same editable budget before you sign a lease
en.runTitle: India to Toronto in May 2027: a CAD 85,000 job offer and a one-bedroom within 40 minutes of downtown by TTC

fields.label: Gross income, currency and earners
fields.value: CAD 85,000 a year from the husband’s job offer; the wife will look for work after arriving

fields.label: Pay cycle
fields.placeholder: e.g. paid every two weeks, first cheque about 4 weeks after the start date

fields.label: Home size, furnished or not, and rent ceiling
Car needs
fields.placeholder: e.g. no car, or one car with parking

fields.label: Debts, remittances, home-country commitments, travel and medical needs
fields.placeholder: e.g. CAD 300 a month sent to family, one trip home a year

en.template: Plan our move to {destination} on {date} from {origin}: household {household}, gross income {income}, pay cycle {paycycle}, office {office}, commute limit {commute}, home {home}, car needs {car}, debts/remittances/home-country commitments/travel/medical needs {commitments}. Use primary payroll, tenancy, transit and health sources plus a meaningful exact rental sample. Keep URLs, read dates, specific-unit versus from-price details, utilities and unknowns; separate confirmed future rules from carried-forward assumptions. Give lean/base/stress costs, first-pay uncertainty, setup cash, refundable deposits, signing commitments and an income-interruption reserve, without double-counting first rent or reserves. Do not assume spouse credits, refunds, benefits, future jobs or health/visa eligibility. Explain tax/insurance omissions and estimated versus measured commutes. Recommend next steps with an editable workbook and source notes. Do not open accounts, contact anyone, apply, buy, book or publish.

phases.title: Check pay, rent, health and transit rules, and read real listings
phases.note: Payroll and tax, Ontario rent rules, OHIP, TTC fares, seven rental listings
phases.judgment: It corrected two outdated assumptions: Ontario has no three-month OHIP waiting period, and the ordinary adult TTC monthly pass has been discontinued, replaced by a fare cap of CAD 155.10 per person per month.

phases.title: Build an editable budget workbook and a phone-friendly summary
phases.note: Seven-sheet workbook with live formulas, plus a mobile summary page
phases.judgment: Take-home pay is labelled as a planning figure, not a 2027 payslip: 2027 pension and EI limits are published but 2027 income-tax rates are not, so it uses 2026 tables, keeps the current 4.95% pension rate because the 4.75% cut is only announced, and assumes no spouse credit or refund.

phases.title: Recalculate, inspect and deliver both files
phases.judgment: The independent colleague recalculated all 46 formulas in a separate copy with no errors, and confirmed the commutes are shown as estimates, not measured journeys.

workers: Worked out take-home pay on CAD 85,000 from Canada.ca and Ontario payroll sources, and checked which 2027 figures are actually published
Read Ontario’s official rules on rent deposits and OHIP for newcomers, plus the current TTC fare cap
Opened seven real one-bedroom listings in subway neighbourhoods and estimated door-to-door commutes
Audited the workbook and summary against the research notes and recalculated every formula in a separate copy

zh.askTitle: 把格子换成你自己的搬迁计划，签租约之前先拿到同样可编辑的预算
zh.runTitle: 从印度搬到多伦多（2027 年 5 月）：年薪 85,000 加元，要坐地铁 40 分钟内到市中心的一居室

fields.label: 城市、省和国家
fields.value: 加拿大安大略省多伦多

fields.label: 家庭成员（成人、儿童、宠物）
税前收入（金额、货币和工作人数）
fields.value: 丈夫的工作邀请年薪 85,000 加元；妻子到后再找工作

fields.label: 发薪周期
fields.placeholder: 例如：每两周发一次薪，首张工资单约在入职后 4 周

fields.label: 通勤上限
fields.value: 坐多伦多公交（TTC）40 分钟

fields.label: 住房（面积、家具和租金上限）
用车需求
fields.placeholder: 例如：不买车，或有一辆车需要停车位

fields.label: 债务、汇款、原居国负担、旅行和医疗
fields.placeholder: 例如：每月给家里汇 300 加元，每年回国一次

zh.template: 请规划我们从{origin}于{date}搬到{destination}的预算：家庭{household}，税前收入{income}，发薪周期{paycycle}，办公室{office}，通勤上限{commute}，住房{home}，用车{car}，债务、汇款、原居国负担、旅行和医疗{commitments}。用工资、租赁、交通和医疗一手来源及有实际意义的具体房源，保留网址、查阅日期、具体单元与起价区别、水电包含项和未知项，分清已确认未来规则与沿用假设。列出节省、基础、压力开支，首薪不确定性、安置现金、可退押金、签约承诺和收入中断储备，别重复算首月租金或储备。不预设配偶抵免、退税、福利、未来就业或医保及签证资格。说明税务保险漏项、通勤是估算还是实测，给建议、可编辑工作簿和来源说明。不要开户、联系他人、申请、购买、预订或发布。

phases.title: 核对工资、租房、医保和交通规则，并读取真实房源
phases.note: 工资与税、安大略租房规则、OHIP、TTC 票价、7 个房源
phases.judgment: 纠正了两条过时的假设：安大略省的 OHIP 没有三个月等待期；TTC 普通成人月票已取消，改为每人每月 155.10 加元的封顶票价。

phases.title: 做成可编辑的预算表和适合手机看的摘要
phases.note: 7 张工作表、带实时公式，另有手机版摘要页
phases.judgment: 税后收入标明是规划数字，不是 2027 年的工资单：2027 年的养老金和失业保险上限已公布，但 2027 年的所得税参数没有，所以沿用 2026 年税表；4.75% 的养老金费率只是宣布过，所以保留现行的 4.95%；也没有假定配偶抵免或退税。

phases.title: 重新计算、检查并交付两份文件
phases.judgment: 独立复核的同事在副本里重算了全部 46 个公式，没有出错，并确认通勤时间是估算，而不是实测行程。

workers: 按 85,000 加元算税后收入，用加拿大联邦和安大略省官方工资扣款资料，并查明哪些 2027 年数字已正式公布
读了安大略省关于押金和新移民医保（OHIP）的官方规定，以及多伦多公交（TTC）现行的封顶票价
打开 7 个地铁沿线的真实一居室房源页面，并估算从家到市中心的通勤时间
对照调研笔记审查预算表和摘要，并在副本里重算全部公式
